description.text: Updated Pediatric Use labeling to describe safety/efficacy results of a pediatric functional constipation study that was terminated early for futility, fulfilling postmarketing requirements (no new pediatric indication added)

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for updates to Section 8.4 *Pediatric Use* of the Prescribing Information to describe the safety and efficacy results of study TAK-555-3010, "Phase 3, Multicenter, Randomized Study with 2 Different Doses of Prucalopride Administered to Male and Female Pediatric Subjects Aged 6 Months to 17 Years with Functional Constipation, Consisting of a 12-week Double blind, Placebo-controlled Part (Part A) to Evaluate Efficacy and Safety Followed by a 36-week Double blind Extension (Part B) to Document Long-term Safety up to Week 48", which was conducted to fulfill postmarketing requirements 3529-1 and 3529-6, and terminated early for futility after the interim analysis indicated the study was unlikely to demonstrate effectiveness.
